label: context.reference
text:
Use the connected GitHub Application through its bound world_mcp_github interface and current MCP catalog. Select repository, issue, pull-request or workflow operations from the task and the server's actual schemas. Resolve the intended repository and target before making a change; inspect related code or discussion when it changes the decision.

When GitHub was connected in Octopus, each server tool is also published as its own github.<tool> operation. The declared operations also include github.call_tool with the catalog tool name and arguments, github.read_resource, github.get_prompt and github.complete. Use github.status or github.ping when connection state is uncertain.

Server tools not declared read-only wait for the operator's approval in Octopus before they reach the server. Their mcp.tool.result arrives after the operator decides; a declined call returns error operator_declined and changed nothing. Do not repeat a call while it waits.

Read the returned MCP result. Resolve an interrupted publication from the target's current state before publishing again. Keep credentials and OAuth state inside their owning interface; use returned handles and status information.
